companyUrl.title: Company URL
companyUrl.description: Canonical LinkedIn company, showcase or school URL, with tracking parameters and locale subdomains stripped.

companyId.title: Company Slug
companyId.description: The public slug from the URL. Stable, human-readable, and the key this actor deduplicates and caches on.

companyIdNumeric.title: Numeric Organization ID
companyIdNumeric.description: LinkedIn's internal numeric organization ID. Every authenticated lookup keys on this, so a company with no numeric ID cannot get a country breakdown.

pageType.title: Page Type
pageType.description: 'company', 'showcase' or 'school'. Showcase pages are sub-brands of a parent company and generally carry far fewer employees than the parent.

success.title: Success
success.description: Whether the company page was fetched and parsed. Always set, on every row.

error.title: Error
error.description: Short explanation when something failed. Set even on success: true rows when only the country breakdown failed, so a partial result is never mistaken for a complete one.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: The short one-line headline under the company name.
tagline.example: We're on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

about.title: About
about.description: Full 'About' text from the company page.

logoUrl.title: Logo
logoUrl.description: Direct URL to the company logo image.

coverImageUrl.title: Cover Image
coverImageUrl.description: Direct URL to the page's banner/cover image.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: LinkedIn's industry classification for the company.

companyType.title: Company Type
companyType.description: Public Company, Privately Held, Nonprofit, Partnership, Self-Employed, Government Agency, and so on.

companySizeRange.title: Company Size Range
companySizeRange.description: LinkedIn's bucketed size band, exactly as displayed. This is a band, not a number — use employeeCount for arithmetic.

employeeCount.title: Employee Count
employeeCount.description: LinkedIn's exact count of members who list this company. Not verified corporate headcount: it counts LinkedIn profiles, so it undercounts workforces that are not on the platform and overcounts stale profiles.

specialties.title: Specialties
specialties.description: Self-declared specialty and focus tags from the About panel. Absent when the section was switched off in the input.

headquarters.title: Headquarters
headquarters.description: HQ city/region as listed on the page.

address.title: Address
address.description: Full structured HQ address where the company publishes one.

locations.title: Office Locations
locations.description: Every office the company declares, as structured campuses: { street, city, region, postalCode, countryCode, country, formattedAddress, isPrimary, mapUrl, addressLines }. Compare against countryBreakdown: declared offices are where a company says it operates, the breakdown is where its staff actually are, and the gap between the two is usually the interesting part.

website.title: Website
website.description: Listed website URL, unwrapped from LinkedIn's outbound redirector.

websiteStatus.title: Website Status
websiteStatus.description: 'valid', 'unresolved' or 'invalid' — whether the listed domain still resolves in DNS. Only present when 'Verify Website Domain' is enabled.

jobOpeningsCount.title: Open Jobs
jobOpeningsCount.description: Number of open jobs posted on the page.

recentUpdates.title: Recent Posts
recentUpdates.description: Recent posts: { text, date, likes, engagement }. Engagement splits reactions from comments rather than collapsing them, because the ratio is what separates a post that landed from one that was merely seen.

affiliatedCompanies.title: Affiliated Companies
affiliatedCompanies.description: Subsidiary, regional, showcase and acquired pages linked from this page: { name, url }.

similarCompanies.title: Similar Companies
similarCompanies.description: LinkedIn's own 'similar pages' suggestions: { name, url }. A quick way to grow a competitor set from one seed company.

featuredEmployees.title: Featured Employees
featuredEmployees.description: The small sample of profiles LinkedIn surfaces publicly: { name, title, photoUrl, profileUrl }. A sample LinkedIn chose to show, not a roster.

countryBreakdown.title: Employees by Country
countryBreakdown.description: Employee headcount per country: { country, employeeCount, percentOfTotal }, sorted by headcount. Requires a session cookie. Counts members who list this company AND a location — treat as a directional signal, not verified headcount.

totalEmployeesOnLinkedIn.title: Total Employees on LinkedIn
totalEmployeesOnLinkedIn.description: The baseline denominator percentOfTotal is computed against: LinkedIn's own count of members listing this company. Per-country figures will not sum to it exactly — members with no listed location land in the total and in no country bucket.

countryScan.title: Country Scan Metadata
countryScan.description: { countriesQueried, stopReason, coverage }. stopReason distinguishes a sweep that exhausted the country list from one truncated by coverage, an empty tail, or the per-company ceiling — so a partial breakdown is never mistaken for a complete one. coverage is the share of the total that was placed in some country.

sourceType.title: Source Type
sourceType.description: 'public' when every field came from the guest page, 'authenticated' when a session cookie was used to obtain the country breakdown.

fromCache.title: From Cache
fromCache.description: Present and true when the row was served from a cached scrape inside the configured TTL rather than re-fetched.

locationIndex.title: Location #
locationIndex.description: Zero-based index of this campus within the company's declared office list. Location mode only.

locationCount.title: Total Locations
locationCount.description: How many offices this company declares in total. Every row for a company carries the same value, so one row tells you the company's footprint size.

isPrimaryLocation.title: Primary
isPrimaryLocation.description: True for the office LinkedIn tags 'Primary' — the headquarters. Exactly one per company, normally.

street.title: Street
street.description: Street address, including any building, tower or floor lines LinkedIn lists above the locality.

region.title: Region
region.description: State, province or region. Null for countries that do not use one (German addresses, for example).

postalCode.title: Postal Code
postalCode.description: Postal or ZIP code. Handles multi-token forms such as UK 'RG6 1WG' and Canadian 'L5N 8L9'.

countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code exactly as LinkedIn publishes it.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country name resolved from the ISO code via the runtime's own ICU data.

formattedAddress.title: Full Address
formattedAddress.description: All address lines joined into one readable string.

mapUrl.title: Map Link
mapUrl.description: The 'Get directions' map URL LinkedIn publishes for this campus.

employeesInCountry.title: Employees in Country
employeesInCountry.description: Headcount in this campus's country, joined from the company's country sweep. Country-level, not campus-level: every campus in the same country carries the same figure, and a country with several offices does not tell you how they split.

percentOfWorkforceInCountry.title: % of Workforce in Country
percentOfWorkforceInCountry.description: This country's share of the company's total LinkedIn headcount.

employeesAtLocation.title: Employees at Location
employeesAtLocation.description: Headcount in this campus's own metro area. Only present when 'Count employees per location' is enabled, and null where the metro could not be resolved.

locationGeoName.title: Matched Metro
locationGeoName.description: The metro LinkedIn actually matched for employeesAtLocation — 'Redmond' resolves to 'Redmond, Washington, United States'. Reported so the number can be checked rather than trusted.

overview.title: Company overview
overview.description: Firmographics, contact details and growth signals.

workforce.title: Global workforce
workforce.description: Employee distribution by country, with the declared offices to compare it against.

campuses.title: Campuses
campuses.description: One row per declared office. Requires Output Mode = one row per location.
